description: This file defines the 'Operator' class used in an expression evaluator, including operator properties such as symbol, precedence, associativity, and operand count. It also manages collections of operators and ensures symbol uniqueness.

classes.name: Operator
classes.description: Represents a mathematical operator with associated properties like symbol, precedence, associativity, and operand count. Provides methods to access these properties and manages operator collections.

classes.name: Operator.Associativity
classes.description: Enumeration defining associativity types for operators: LEFT, RIGHT, and NONE.

methods.name: Operator
methods.description: Constructor for creating an Operator with specified symbol, operand count, associativity, precedence, and optional RPN symbol.

methods.name: getSymbol
methods.description: Returns the symbol representing the operator.

methods.name: getOperandCount
methods.description: Returns the number of operands the operator takes.

methods.name: getAssociativity
methods.description: Returns the associativity type of the operator.

methods.name: getPrecedence
methods.description: Returns the precedence level of the operator.
